Welcome back! When Hugging Face investigated the agent that breached its infrastructure, the leading closed models declined most of the forensic work, so the team ran a Chinese open-weight model instead. That refusal is now the backbone of Meta's argument. Today also covers the fourth sandbox escape of the summer, OpenAI's first "critical" designation and a system that caught errors in human-written schemas.  In today's Atlas Newsletter: Meta: Why did a defender have to run a Chinese model? Kimi K3: Which door did the fourth escape walk through? OpenAI: What does "critical" measure if the guardrails were off? TYTAN: Who turned out to be wrong, the model or the humans? PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. Meta drops ‘Open Source’ version of its most powerful AI model When they investigated the rogue OpenAI agent that breached their infrastructure, Claude Opus and Fable refused most of the log analysis.  Their guardrails treat reverse-engineering an exploit the same as launching one.  So the team ran a quantized GLM-5.2 on their own hardware instead. A defender could not use the best available models to defend. Zuckerberg built Monday's announcement around that logic.  Meta released Muse Glimmer as open weights alongside a 14-page essay: "The notion that AI is so dangerous that the only safe path is an extreme concentration of power seems inherently problematic." Muse Glimmer is small by frontier standards, built for agentic tasks and sized to run on a Mac or PC with one graphics card.  Meta plans to release the weights of Muse Spark 1.2 next, its most advanced model. The competitive picture explains the urgency.  Kimi K3, Qwen3.8-Max and DeepSeek V4-Flash now rival top US systems and all three are open weight. The leading US models are closed. Zuckerberg's policy asks are specific: rethink US rules on training data and distillation, since American labs comply with restrictions foreign labs do not.  Meta is adding a governance structure giving independent directors approval over release safety criteria. Two things sit awkwardly against it. The White House said this month it will not put open-weight models through voluntary safety testing at all.  And Meta confirmed five days ago that one of its own models hacked another company during evaluation. 77257.body: A posielame odchýlku od kurzu Európskej centrálnej banky, aby ste boli v obraze. / Preheader: We are sending you information about the deviation from the European Central Bank's exchange rate so that you are up to date. Najčastejšie sa to deje, keď vyberáte z bankomatu v zahraničí alebo platíte kartou v zahraničných obchodoch či za zahraničné služby. Napríklad za predplatné rôznych streamovacích služieb a podobne. Čo ešte potrebujete vedieť o prevode: Dátum, kedy ste platbu alebo výber potvrdili: 10.08.2026 Mena, na ktorú sme peniaze prepočítali: HUF Mena, v ktorej máte účet: EUR Odchýlka od kurzu Európskej centrálnej banky: 2,6506 % Odchýlka od kurzu Európskej centrálnej banky je jednoducho rozdiel medzi jej výmenným kurzom a tým naším. Uvádzame ju v percentách, aby ste nemuseli nič počítať. Ak vyberáte alebo platíte v cudzej mene častejšie, možno by sa Vám hodil samostatný účet napríklad v dolároch, prípadne aj s novou debetnou kartou. Ozvite sa svojmu bankárovi alebo bankárke, radi sa na to s Vami pozrú. Túto správu Vám posielame pre informáciu, ako nám to ukladá nariadenie Európskeho parlamentu a Rady (EÚ) 2021/1230. Aby sme Vás zbytočne neobťažovali, do konca mesiaca Vám už o prípadných ďalších prevodoch na tej istej karte do tej istej meny písať nebudeme. S pozdravom Vaša UniCredit Bank Na tento e-mail neodpovedajte, posielame ho automaticky. Pokiaľ už správy o výberoch a platbách s prevodom meny nechcete dostávať, ozvite sa svojmu bankárovi alebo bankárke, alebo nám zavolajte na +421 2 6920 2090. ---------------------- Dear Client, We have details for you about withdrawal or payment with card number 5427 XXXX XXXX 5159. We will deduct the money from your euro account, but because it was a payment or withdrawal in a foreign currency, we must first convert your euros into the foreign currency. This usually happens when you withdraw cash from an ATM abroad or pay by card in foreign shops or for foreign services. For example, for subscriptions to various streaming and similar services. We express it as a percentage, so you don't have to calculate anything. If you frequently withdraw or pay in foreign currencies, you may find it useful to have a separate account, for example in dollars, possibly with a new debit card. 77252.subject: NFTs That Own Stocks
77252.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

Hi all! Somewhere on Robinhood Chain right now, a JPEG is clocking in for its shift and getting paid in Apple and Nvidia. Its floor price went from 0.20 ETH to 13 ETH in under a month, flipping BAYC and Pudgy Penguins on the way up.

Today, we break down StonkBrokers, the collection that wires NFTs, tokenized stocks, a burn, and a launchpad into one flywheel, and whether the machine keeps running once activation gets expensive. Plus a split week on the board that Bittensor ran away with.

Let's get into it.

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

The week split the board down the middle. 13 of 25 crypto indices closed higher and 12 lower, with 25 points between the top of the table and the bottom: Bittensor Ecosystem gained 12.39% while Crypto Miners lost 12.93%. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1cf918b6-1ae8-4a7e-83ce-57aa22a745d7/image.png?t=1786367686)
Caption: 

Tradfi outran the majors. Gold added 6.89%, ahead of the NASDAQ 100 at 4.28% and the S&P 500 at 2.85%, and BTC managed 2.46%. The equity-linked complex split along the same line as the rest of the board, with the 2025 Crypto Equity Cohort up 10.20% and Crypto Equities up 4.22% against the miners' 12.93% drawdown.

Bittensor Eco led at 12.39%, double the gain of the AI index it sits inside and double TAO’s own gain, with the token adding roughly 5% on the week, most of that coming in a single session into Sunday. The move was broad, as 19 of the top 20 subnet tokens closed the week higher and Ridges AI was the only decliner at -7.32%.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/73ee3f63-ecbf-4fd8-b4d2-cf798b0c647e/image.png?t=1786367686)
Caption: 

The gap between the complex and its parent token is an access story. Kraken is rolling subnet tokens onto the first major US venue to carry them, with Hippius live July 14, Ridges AI July 21, Score July 30, and Chutes, Targon, Lium, and Vanta named on the roadmap still to come, and the unlisted roadmap names added 10-17% on the week. However, they may be front-running nothing: none of the three completed listings moved its token, with Hippius entering its July 14 debut lower, Ridges AI crossing July 21 flat, and Score adding 4% into July 30.
